headlines.title_en: PBOC injects net 50 billion yuan via open market government bond operations in July
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC announced liquidity injections for July 2026 across various tools. In central bank lending: Standing Lending Facility (SLF) saw a net withdrawal of 1.0 billion yuan; Medium-term Lending Facility (MLF) saw a net injection of 100.0 billion yuan; Pledged Supplementary Lending (PSL) saw a net withdrawal of 116.1 billion yuan. In open market operations: 7-day reverse repos saw a net injection of 249.5 billion yuan; open market treasury bond trading saw a net injection of 50.0 billion yuan; central treasury cash management saw a net injection of 30.0 billion yuan.

headlines.summary: 为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年8月5日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为3个月（92天），到期日为2026年11月5日（遇节假日顺延）。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: To conduct 500 billion yuan outright reverse repos on Aug 5, with 3-month tenor
headlines.summary_en: To maintain ample liquidity in the banking system, on August 5, 2026, the People's Bank of China will conduct a 500.0 billion yuan outright reverse repo operation with a 3-month (92-day) term using fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price auction methods. The maturity date is November 5, 2026 (postponed if holidays occur).

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国债务比率回落，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 4 - Nanjing Securities announced that it recently received approval from the CSRC to publicly issue corporate bonds to professional investors with a total face value of no more than 20.0 billion yuan. headlines.title: 国金证券：监管层面释放两地互联互通政策红利 维持证券行业买入评级
headlines.summary: 国金证券发布研报称，监管层面持续释放互联互通的政策红利，将提高两地资本市场活跃度、丰富产品供给、提升中国资产的全球配置价值。香港交易所以及提供跨境融资、投资端服务的优质券商有望在长期受益。当前证券板块PB、PE估值为1.2x/16x倍，多家券商发布中期业绩预增公告，维持低估值、高业绩增速的证券行业的“买入”评级。

headlines.title_en: Sinolink Securities: Regulators release cross-border connectivity policy dividends; maintain Buy rating on securities sector
headlines.summary_en: Sinolink Securities released a research report stating that continued policy dividends on connectivity at the regulatory level will increase the activity of both markets, enrich product supply, and enhance the global allocation value of Chinese assets. Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, as well as quality brokerages providing cross-border financing and investment services, are expected to benefit long-term. The current securities sector PB and PE valuations are 1.2x/16x. Multiple brokerages have released interim earnings forecasts, maintaining a "Buy" rating on the securities industry with low valuations and high earnings growth.

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext surges 5.64% on heavy volume; computing hardware stocks rebound broadly
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market rebounded throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index leading gains strongly. CPO, PCB and other computing hardware sectors surged, with multiple stocks hitting the daily limit including Lighton Technology, CIG, WUS Printed Circuit, and Shennan Circuits. Semiconductor chip stocks rallied, with Halmicro and Jinhai Tong hitting limit-up. Computing power leasing concepts rallied, with Xingyun Technology, Hongjing Technology, and Qingyun Technology all hitting 20cm limit-up. Innovative drug concept stocks rallied, with WuXi AppTec and Ha Sanlian hitting limit-up. On the downside, the banking sector fell against the trend, with the four major state-owned banks all declining over 3%. Gains outweighed losses, with over 3,600 stocks rising across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets. Today's turnover was 2.23 trillion yuan. As of close: Shanghai Composite Index up 0.33%, Shenzhen Component Index up 3.25%, ChiNext Index up 5.64%. 2. By sector concept: CPO, PCB, semiconductor chips, and computing power leasing led gains; banking, insurance, passenger vehicles, and baijiu lagged.

headlines.title: 工业富联：截至2026年7月31日，公司尚未实施股份回购
headlines.summary: 2026年7月27日公司审议通过了《关于以集中竞价交易方式回购公司股份的议案》。公司拟使用自有资金不低于人民币10亿元（含）且不超过人民币20亿元（含），以集中竞价交易方式进行股份回购，回购股份的价格不超过人民币103元/股，本次回购股份的目的系维护公司价值及股东权益，所回购股份将按照有关规定用于出售，逾期未实施出售的部分将依法予以注销。截至2026年7月31日，公司尚未实施股份回购。截至公告日，公司回购方案不存在变更或终止的情况。

headlines.title_en: Foxconn Industrial Internet: As of July 31, 2026, company has not yet implemented share buybacks
headlines.summary_en: On July 27, 2026, the company approved the resolution on repurchasing company shares through centralized competitive bidding trading. The company plans to use its own funds of no less than 1.0 billion yuan and no more than 2.0 billion yuan to repurchase shares through centralized competitive bidding, with a repurchase price not exceeding 103 yuan per share. The purpose is to maintain company value and shareholder interests, and the repurchased shares will be sold in accordance with relevant regulations, with any unsold portion to be cancelled as required by law. As of July 31, 2026, the company has not yet implemented the share repurchase. As of the announcement date, there have been no changes or terminations to the company's repurchase plan.

headlines.title: 工信部：对于L3级自动驾驶系统应具备驾驶人接管能力监测功能
headlines.summary: 《智能网联汽车 自动驾驶系统安全要求》强制性国家标准正式发布。拟于2027年7月1日起正式实施。其中提到，该标准立足我国产业发展与行业监管实际需求，兼顾技术可行性、产业适配性与落地实操性，构建了维度完整、要求清晰、适配国情的安全要求体系。规范人机交互与用户告知要求，防范误用滥用风险。标准要求自动驾驶系统的激活和退出过程应安全，并明确就绪、激活、退出等状态信息及信号的提示规范。对于L3级自动驾驶系统还应具备驾驶人接管能力监测功能。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: L3-level autonomous driving systems should include driver takeover capability monitoring functions
headlines.summary_en: The mandatory national standard for safety requirements of automated driving systems for intelligent connected vehicles has been officially released and is scheduled to take effect on July 1, 2027. The standard is based on the actual needs of China's industrial development and industry regulation, balancing technical feasibility, industrial adaptability, and practical implementation, establishing a comprehensive, clearly defined safety requirement system suited to national conditions. It regulates human-machine interaction and user notification requirements to prevent risks of misuse and abuse. The standard requires that the activation and exit processes of automated driving systems be safe, with clear specifications for status information such as ready, activation, and exit, as well as signal prompts. For L3-level automated driving systems, driver takeover capability monitoring functions are also required.

headlines.title_en: Jingsong Intelligent: Plans to repurchase company shares for 15 million-20 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Jingsong Intelligent announced plans to repurchase company shares with no less than 15 million yuan and no more than 20 million yuan, at a repurchase price not exceeding 33 yuan per share. All repurchased shares will be used for employee stock ownership plans or equity incentives. The repurchase funding comes from self-owned funds and special share repurchase loans. The company has obtained a loan commitment letter from Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. Hefei Branch.

headlines.title: 彭博：中国AI闪击战为美国竞争对手大模型厂商制造“死亡地带”
headlines.summary: 据彭博，中国人工智能(AI)领域密集推出的大模型正迅速缩小与硅谷的差距，并创造了一个被形容为“死亡地带”的竞争环境。任何不具备前沿突破性技术或打破市场定价能力的企业，都将在此面临灭顶之灾。 阿里巴巴的Qwen3.8-Max和月之暗面的Kimi K3已展现出与美国同类产品不相上下的性能，这引发了外界对美国旨在减缓中国技术崛起而实施的芯片制裁有效性的质疑。 中国在AI领域的进步不再看起来只是单一公司的突破，而是已经形成了一套可复制的系统，能够生产接近全球前沿水平的模型，且其开发者在能力和定价方面正逐步接近或超越美国的先驱企业。

headlines.title_en: Bloomberg: China's AI blitz creates 'death zone' for U.S. rival large model makers
headlines.summary_en: According to Bloomberg, the wave of large language models launched intensively in China's AI sector is rapidly closing the gap with Silicon Valley and has created a competitive environment described as a "death zone." Any company lacking frontier breakthrough technology or the ability to disrupt market pricing will face doom here. Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max and Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 have demonstrated performance comparable to US counterparts, raising questions about the effectiveness of US chip sanctions aimed at slowing China's technological rise. China's progress in AI no longer looks like a breakthrough from a single company, but has formed a replicable system capable of producing models near the global frontier, with developers gradually approaching or exceeding their American pioneers in capability and pricing.

headlines.summary_en: Southbound capital recorded a net purchase of 2.57 billion yuan today. headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部装备工业一司8月4日组织道路机动车辆检验检测机构开展座谈，分析当前产品安全和检验检测工作形势，部署规范道路机动车辆检验检测行业竞争秩序、提升检验检测工作质量相关工作。会议要求，道路机动车辆检验检测机构要深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，坚决抵制非理性竞争，严把产品检测关。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Strengthen identification and testing of risks from 'radical' innovative designs in road motor vehicle products; enhance safety assessments for combined driver assistance and autonomous driving functions
headlines.summary_en: On August 4, the Equipment Industry Division No. 1 of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology organized a symposium with road motor vehicle inspection and testing institutions to analyze the current situation of product safety and inspection testing work, and to deploy efforts to regulate the competitive order of the road motor vehicle inspection and testing industry and improve the quality of inspection and testing work. The meeting required that road motor vehicle inspection and testing institutions thoroughly implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, resolutely resist irrational competition, and strictly enforce product testing standards.
